verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are themselves fresh, isolated, ephemeral containers for running untrusted user or agent code. Network controls (block_network, outbound and inbound allowlists) and opt-in volume mounts let a user test without exposing production systems or data, and snapshots allow repeatable test states. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of separate dev/test vs production environments or data isolation guarantees, and no independent hands-on corroboration that production data stays untouched.
